column2: Look at the top edge of the screen: that is your notch.
Each switch adds one entry to the agent config and backs up the old file. It applies to new sessions.
Pair your phone to answer agents from the lock screen when away from your computer.
Point at the notch at the top of the screen.
The Control Panel and Quit buttons are at the bottom right of the open notch.
The menu bar icon also opens the Control Panel when enabled.
